subject: Project Tundra kickoff - one fine-tuning framework for every modality
body:
Team,

Kicking off the Uboreshaji Modeli productization. Internal codename is Project Tundra - use it on all planning artifacts and in the budget tool.

What we're building on: the framework started as OWL-v2 object detection (DETR-style boxes with HungarianMatcher and SetCriterion focal loss) and has been extended into a genuinely multi-modal fine-tuning stack - vision-language detection and instance segmentation via location tokenization, text SFT with chat templating and prompt masking, and ASR fine-tuning with USM encoder integration under Seq2SeqTrainer. The Composable Strategy Pattern is what makes it saleable: customers configure workflows, they don't fork code.

Why now: the vision portfolio runs four different fine-tuning stacks across customer engagements. Tundra collapses them into one.

Milestones: detection + text SFT paths hardened by May 15; ASR path by June 12; first external customer engagement on Tundra by July 10.

Daniela - staffing and compute please.

Lucia
